title: Add optional semantic fields to `ProblemIR`: `fields`, `domain`, `mesh_contract`, `residual_contract`.

plan_assets.asset_description: Action-item row P3-1 (R2.1) in Phase 3 table

implementation_steps: Read the recovery plan section for Phase 3 (Enrich `ProblemIR` into the semantic center again (R2)) and the task's row in the action-item table to scope the change.
Apply the action: Add optional semantic fields to ProblemIR: fields, domain, mesh_contract, residual_contract.
Add ProblemIR.to_dict() and ProblemIR.from_dict() (the existing serialisation lives only on BoundaryCondition and MaterialSpec — see Phase-3 Code reality anchor).
Verify: round-trip ProblemIR through to_dict/from_dict on both old and new forms.
Update the task JSON status to done after Gate C passes.
acceptance_criteria: ProblemIR.to_dict() and ProblemIR.from_dict() round-trip both legacy and enriched ProblemIR instances byte-identical (modulo field order).
New optional fields fields, domain, mesh_contract, residual_contract default to None on legacy constructors so existing tests keep passing.
No regressions on the existing test suite.

cases: P3-1-c1: Serialization + round-trip tests preserve old and new forms.
P3-1-c2: deliverables present at the listed surfaces

risks: IR enrichment breaks downstream code. Mitigation: Use additive fields and compatibility constructors; land with focused regression tests.
completion_notes: Added FieldSpec / DomainSpec / MeshContract / ResidualContract frozen dataclasses with to_dict/from_dict; ProblemIR carries them as 4 new optional fields with safe defaults (empty tuple / None). to_dict always emits the new keys for forward consumers; from_dict accepts both legacy and enriched dicts. Backward compat verified: 325/325 across IR / codegen / e2e / localise / einsum / docs / full_pipeline. Gate A PASS (spec compliance: 4 named fields exactly per recovery R2.1, immutable, no leakage). Gate B PASS with 2 minor advisory findings (mutable dict in frozen-dataclass metadata bag is intentional; FieldSpec.kind validation deferred to P3-5).
